title: Can a Dad's Stress Slow Down Labor?
card: Doula Mahika has watched labor speed up after a stressed dad left the room. Why she thinks it happens, and what she asks fathers to do instead.
llms: Video interview with Mahika, a birth doula, who has seen labor speed up after a stressed dad left the room; she explains why she asks fathers to stay grounded, trust the midwife and doula, and take care of themselves instead of trying to run the birth.
